params.prompt: Full-body character design: the forge town's handyman, a broad-shouldered, barrel-chested repairman in his fifties with a short grey beard and a shaved head, brass welding goggles pushed up on his forehead. He wears a mustard-yellow canvas work coat with the sleeves rolled to the elbow over a teal shirt, a wide leather tool belt hung with a coiled steel measuring tape and a small iron bench clamp, thick tan leather gloves, dark trousers and heavy steel-capped boots. In his right hand he holds an oversized long-handled copper wrench, almost as tall as his chest, resting head-down beside him. Friendly, stubborn expression. Front view, standing upright, feet apart, arms held a little away from the body. Chunky stylised proportions, clean readable shapes, hand-painted look, an original character for a stylised 3D video game set in a mountain forge town. Soft even studio lighting, plain light grey background, no text, no cast shadows.
